with recursive d (lot_id, lvl, path) as ( select #{lotId}::bigint, 0, array[#{lotId}::bigint] union select g.child_lot_id, d.lvl + 1, d.path || g.child_lot_id from d join lot_genealogy g on g.parent_lot_id = d.lot_id where d.lvl < #{depth} and not g.child_lot_id = any(d.path) and g.reversal_of_id is null and not exists (select 1 from lot_genealogy x where x.reversal_of_id = g.gen_id) ), lots as (select lot_id, min(lvl) as lvl from d group by lot_id) select , case when lots.lvl = 0 then null else pl.lot_no end as via from lots join prd_serial_part p on p.part_lot_id = lots.lot_id and p.ev_type = 'INSTALL'
order by s.serial_no, p.part_id limit #{limit}
